sonido/6048202:
Two complementary systems for musically intelligent transitions:

Spillover (graph engine):
- SpilloverTail keeps removed effects alive when tail_samples > 0
- Fed silence each block, output mixed with exponential fade-out
- tail_samples() added to Effect trait (default 0); Chain delegates as
  max(first, second); Adapter delegates to kernel
- set_spillover()/spillover_count() on ProcessingGraph
- Reverb tails now survive preset changes and effect scrolling

MorphSpace (kernel layer):
- 1D morph (2 snapshots, A↔B) — equivalent to KernelParams::lerp but
  with per-param curve control
- 2D morph (4 snapshots, bilinear) — for XY pad / expression+footswitch
- MorphCurve: Linear (default), Logarithmic (frequency params, geometric
  mean at t=0.5), Snap (STEPPED params, midpoint threshold)
- auto_curves() detects curve type from ParamDescriptor flags/scale

These enable "reverb before delay" → "delay before reverb" morphing
(future Phase 11 topology morph builds on the spillover mechanism).
sonido/6007b24:
Replace libm transcendentals with fast_math approximations on hot paths
and add block-rate coefficient decimation to the two worst offenders.

LFO: sinf(phase*2π) → fast_sin_turns(phase). Cross-cutting win —
affects Chorus, Flanger, Tremolo, MultiVibrato, Phaser.

Compressor: linear_to_db/db_to_linear → fast variants in process loop.
Keeps exact functions for parameter setters (non-hot path).

CleanPreamp: cache powf(10, headroom_db/20) — headroom_db is a plain
f32 that only changes on setter call, was recomputed every sample.

Gate: cache db_to_linear(threshold) — only recompute while the
SmoothedParam is ramping (!is_settled()).

ParametricEq: decimate peaking_eq_coefficients() calls from per-sample
to every 32 samples during transitions. 0.67ms at 48kHz is perceptually
transparent for filter sweeps. Steady-state unchanged (settled
short-circuit skips entirely).

Phaser: same 32-sample decimation for allpass coefficient updates +
fast_tan for allpass coefficients + fast_exp2∘fast_log2 replacing powf
for exponential frequency sweep. LFOs still advance every sample.

Golden files regenerated for all affected effects.
